test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following teams was defeated by the Indian Hockey team to win the bronze medal in Asian Champions Trophy 2021 on December 22, 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __Pakistan__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India defeated Pakistan 4-3** in a thriller to finish third in the Asian Champions Trophy Hockey 2021 in Dhaka.
 
• Both the teams fought from the start but in the end, it was the big-match experience that made all the difference.
 
• The tournament was **eventually held from 14 to 22 December 2021.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e62aede83e01431883d1c54fcdf98bae5e845818a83138781a3907ce0f92627f.png] 

 
• Asian Champions Trophy 2021:** Harmanpreet Singh, Sumit, Varun Kumar and Akashdeep Singh** scored the goals for India.
 
• While Arfraz, Abdul Rana and Nadeem were the scorers for Pakistan in the third-place playoff in Dhaka.
